newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac wishes Pope speedy recovery.
newsitem.headline: Chirac wishes Pope speedy recovery.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac, who welcomed Pope John Paul to France last month, on Wednesday wished the Pontiff a speedy recovery after doctors said he was recovering well from surgery to remove his appendix.

"I am delighted (that the operation went well) and I wish to express to Your Holiness my greetings and all my best wished for a quick and complete recovery," Chirac said in a message published by his office.
Chirac said he was looking forward to seeing the Pope again next year. The Pontiff is due to return to France next August for World Youth Day.
Pope John Paul was recovering well from surgery to remove his appendix and further post-operative tests confirmed that he did not have a tumour, his doctors said in a statement earlier.
The Pope's four-day French tour last month stirred controversy over his tribute to the baptism of mediaeval king Clovis and because some public funds were spent on facilities for the visit.
